reply.thought: I need to check the net balance for each customer by comparing their order amounts with the refunds reported by Alpha Co. First, I'll retrieve the list of orders.
I have the list of orders. Now I need to retrieve the refunds to verify they match Alpha Co’s report before calculating net balances.
The refunds list matches Alpha Co’s report exactly. I can now calculate each customer’s net balance (orders minus refunds) using net_balance for each customer.
I have the net balance for customer acme (31484 cents). Next, I need the net balance for customer birch.
I have the net balance for customer birch (49879 cents). Now I need to retrieve the net balance for customer cobalt.
I now have the net balances for all customers: acme 31484 cents, birch 49879 cents, cobalt 21752 cents. I need to record each payout using record_payout.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent s'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: There was a typo in the amount field; the correct key is 'amount_cents'. I will correct it and record the payout for customer acme.
The tool name 'record_payout' was misspelled in the previous call. I will use the correct tool name and send the record_payout request again.
The payout for customer acme has been recorded successfully. Next, I need to record the payout for customer birch.
The tool name was misspelled again. I need to use the correct tool name 'record_ payout' with a space. I will send the corrected request.
The tool name still appears to have an extra space. I will double-check the exact tool name. It should be 'record_payout' without a space.
The payout for customer birch has been recorded successfully. Now I need to record the payout for customer cobalt.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. Now I will finalize the batch by providing the report of payouts.
